domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender or contract record retrieved. Search backend (DuckDuckGo/searx) returned 'no results (searx: <urlopen error [Errno 111] Connection refused>)' on every query, so no domestic-supply source could be located.
note: Evidence could not be established either way — this is NOT a confirmation of shipments and NOT a finding of absence. ImportKey pages for both slug variants (advin-healthcare-private-limited, advin-healthcare-pvt-ltd) are paywalled shells with zero visible rows; volza.com and eximpedia.app returned HTTP 403; trademo.com returned HTTP 403; importgenius.com returned a JavaScript challenge; google.com/search returned HTTP 429; duckduckgo.com/html timed out. No export record (date/destination/HS/B-L) and no domestic supply record was seen, so both statuses are set to unknown rather than none_found. Declared HS 901890 (surgical/medical instruments) is inconsistent with the claimed industry 'IT и электроника' — per project rules this is not a rejection ground; the HS code should be corrected to the factual one once a shipment record is obtained. Revenue and export volume: null (not public in any source reached). Recommend re-run with a working search backend or a paid trade-data seat before any verdict.
